text: I do not need this right now, but I am interested next month. Please tell me the current price; do not book anything or call this a permanent rejection.
Understood. Visiting cards are twenty-five rupees per card with a minimum of one hundred cards. Wedding invitations depend on design and quantity, so there is no fixed price.
Yes, I am still interested in future. I am not asking you to call me later right now. What should I know about the service?

For delivery to Pune, it takes five working days after artwork approval. We accept cards and cash on delivery. Our office is open from ten AM to six PM, Monday to Saturday. Which type of card are you looking at, visiting cards or wedding invitations?
You have answered my questions. I do not need anything else. Goodbye, end the call.
Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
